description: ASL-to-ISL Grammar Translation Rules and Mapping Tables

subject_verb_order.description: ASL uses topic-comment order; ISL may require subject-verb-object
subject_verb_order.rule: Reorder gloss sequence from (Topic, Comment) to (Subject, Verb, Object)

tense_marking.description: ASL marks tense through facial expressions; ISL uses explicit tense markers

classifier_predicates.description: Both languages use classifiers, but mapping differs

number_agreement.description: ISL may require explicit number marking
number_agreement.rule: If COUNT is present, append _SG (singular) or _PL (plural) to following noun

negation.description: ASL uses head shake; ISL uses explicit negation marker

filter_rules.description: Remove filler and discourse markers before translation for cleaner output
